notes.title: MUSIC OF THE PAST AND THE PRESENT
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We are pleased to announce you that the Original Soundtrack of Yesterday Origins, composed by Juan Miguel Martìn (Yesterday/New York Crimes, The Next Big Thing/Hollywood Monster 2, Runaway - A Twist Of Fate) is available online!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25308514/bce09328a9e77ab56cdaf68c5ab806b15624a3a0.gif[/img]

In YO, musics play a key role to create the unique atmosphere of the game. From medieval time to the present day, from different countries and cultures, dark thriller ambiance to light-hearted comedy, it was quite a challenge!

Besides, they also have a role of representation regarding the identities and states of mind of our immortal heroes. Indeed, it changes when you switch between John and Pauline. 

Freely listen to it on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DU7sLL31Buc&list=PLKsgrVEYiM3U97B5_K_Kg_yWZcIPGyJTC]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://play.spotify.com/album/0vAIJbhCkr6WGMEa58HVxA]Spotify[/url], or download it on the [url=https://itunes.apple.com/fr/album/yesterday-origins-original/id1180946171]iTunes Store[/url]. 

Happy Holiday Season!

notes.title: Pendulo Launch New Adventure Game, Yesterday Origins
notes.content: Pendulo Studios, the makers of The Next Big Thing and the Runaway series, this week released their latest adventure game. It’s Yesterday Origins [official site], the follow-up to 2012’s Yesterday. It’s a tale of immortality and power struggles, with a visual style I find quite interesting. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Yesterday Origins postponed for a good purpose!
notes.content:
Awaited by all Pendulo Studios’ fans and adventure games’ enthusiasts, Yesterday Origins’ release date is postponed until November 10th.

“We wish to offer to players all around the world, the possibility to play this new masterpiece of Pendulo Studios simultaneously on all physical and digital platforms.“ Declares Eliott Grassiano, Microïds VP. 

“Unfortunately, due to manufacturing processes taking longer than expected, we are not able to deliver all territories at the same time. That’s why we take the decision to postpone the launch of the game until November 10, 2016.”

notes.title: Contest: Share your best memory
notes.content:
In Yesterday Origins, memory is priceless. If you had to choose among your memories, which one would be the most precious?

Like and answer the question above on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/microids/posts/10153712298877405]Facebook page[/url] to have a chance to win one of the 5 copies of the game Yesterday Origins at stake. 

In addition, if you post a fan art with your answer, you could win one of another 5 copies autographed by Pendulo Studios. 

All winners will be selected by random.org. You have till 2016 August 15 to enter the contest. 

Good luck!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wcGLBN1oC1s
